enabled.label: Enable speech services
enabled.description: Allow voice input and read aloud through this site.

max_recording_seconds.label: Recording duration
max_recording_seconds.description: 10–1800 seconds per recording. The selected channel's limit also applies.

max_concurrent_per_user.label: Concurrent requests per user
max_concurrent_per_user.description: Simultaneous speech requests per user, from 1 to 8.

doubao_enabled.label: Doubao Input
doubao_enabled.description: Allow voice input with Doubao Input.

deepseek_asr_enabled.label: Voice input
deepseek_asr_enabled.description: Transcribe after recording ends, up to 120 seconds per recording.

deepseek_tts_enabled.label: Read aloud
deepseek_tts_enabled.description: Allow replies to be played as speech.

deepseek_base_url.label: Service URL
deepseek_base_url.description: API URL for DeepSeek speech services.

deepseek_api_key.label: API Key
deepseek_api_key.description: Shared by voice input and read aloud. Leave blank to keep the saved key.

asr_cny_per_hour.label: Voice input rate
asr_cny_per_hour.description: CNY per hour of recorded audio. Set to 0 for free use.

tts_cny_per_10000_characters.label: Read aloud rate
tts_cny_per_10000_characters.description: CNY per 10,000 billable characters. Chinese characters count as 2. Set to 0 for free use.
